اعلوطتا (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطَتَا (iʕlawwaṭatā) /iʕ.law.wa.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطَتَا (uʕluwwiṭatā) /uʕ.luw.wi.tˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
